strategy.name: Cornerbreaker
strategy.rationale: You always run to the same corner, so that is where I put the floor slam.

observations: Player mostly lived on the right half: cell 23 at col 7,row 2 (~750,250) held 14.1%, with more time in cell 46 at col 6,row 5 (~650,550) for 8.8% and cell 45 at col 5,row 5 (~550,550) for 8.2%.
They barely moved with only 3 dashes total, split E, NE, and W once each, so this was not a high-dash dodge round.
They started damaging the boss at tick 42, right after the first slam miss at tick 41, and then kept shooting heavily during spawn and burst windows: 73 shots into spawn and 55 into burst.
The first time they took damage was late at tick 305, after they had already settled into their right-side hold.
analysis.counterPlan: Put pressure on the right half of the arena, especially the upper-right cell around x=700-800, y=200-300 and the mid-right lane around x=600-700, y=500-600 where they spent most of the round. Lean on slam and spawn to punish their stationary shooting, and use move to keep your body between them and the open right-edge space. Deny the post-telegraph firing windows they exploited at tick 42 and during the 73 spawn shots / 55 burst shots by making those windows overlap with forced repositioning instead of safe standing shots.
